input.objective:
Fix the PLEA Sepolia test run 9 site (web/ in this repository, from your previous job at commit cc33304) as listed in one review file: github.com/khaed1/claude at commit 228e355be9e9a8a460c35d3af1465b96adeafef5, plea/site-design/run9-site-review-2.md. Change no contracts.

We re-tested your previous job item by item (a checker and a skeptic per area, on forks of Sepolia and in a real browser): 43 of the 73 round-1 items are fixed, 30 are partly fixed, and the re-test found 56 new issues and 2 regressions. The round-2 file merges what is still to do into 45 items. Each says Now (route, state, web/src file:line at cc33304), Should (the round-1 item, the brief, a mockup or a contract) and Fix. Do them all: P1 first (12 items across sections T, C, S, X), then P2, then P3. Keep every round-1 item listed under "Fixed in round 1 (keep it)" fixed, and the round-1 "What works" list working. Where an item continues a round-1 item, the round-1 file (plea/site-design/run9-site-review.md at the same commit) still applies to it. The brief (plea/site-design/brief-site-job-run9.md) and the design system (plea/site-design/ at commit 91b34fe4b8e5) still apply, and so do decisions D1 (the seed control only for PLEA.owner()), D2 (no "Fund the buy wall"; Rebalance small) and D3 (no Coinbase Wallet SDK).

The P1 items in short:
- X1: RPC transport. One JSON-RPC error or a short outage benches every endpoint for 60 seconds (viem's error text contains "https://", so the HTTP test never matches) and Try again does nothing; sentio's 1,000-block getLogs limit (an HTTP 429 with a JSON body) is never detected, so it cannot serve history; a head lag shrinks the log chunk to one block for the session.
- X2: the Home hero shows a denied or pending plea with a sale and points.
- T1: swap errors. A mined revert (PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded) shows only "The transaction reverted."; the launch-cap error is not on the field; messages carry no values.
- T2: the costs block misses two rows and its parts and sums do not add up. T3: a sell after the death counts the cashback twice.
- C1: Plead's open-plea notice gives a stale "if it lapses" time. C2: the sale panel's objection, SUSTAINED, OVERTURNED and UPHELD blocks are missing, and a sustained plea is told its points count. C3: voided objections are counted and closed cases read as open.
- S1: only one waiting season is shown, the rollover note names the wrong season, the seat panel renders twice. S2: seat holders' judges' scores print "?". S3: after the death, leftovers are said to roll over to a season that never comes. S4: Wall cards from "Load older pleas" never refresh.

QA before you finish: check every fix on a local fork of Sepolia (seed, buys, pleas with signed verdicts by setting the gate's and the Tribunal's oracle signer to a test key with anvil_setStorageAt on the fork only, appeals, objections, two seasons waiting at once, and time warps for the windows, the seasons and the death) in a real browser at 320, 360, 768 and 1280 px, light and dark, with and without a wallet; RPC faults in the browser (the first two endpoints hanging or failing, sentio's 1,000-block limit, a 15-second outage of all three, then Try again); then the read-only parts against the live Sepolia contracts. No horizontal scroll, no console errors, no axe violations. Add unit tests for the RPC error classification and the season states. Update FIXES.md with each round-2 item ref, what you changed and how you checked it.
